subject.title: Add gated Claw discovery and API projection

question: Should Claw packages become an experimental family on the existing public package API under CLAWHUB_EXPERIMENTAL_CLAWS=1?
rationale: This changes an established public package contract and adds deployment configuration while the governing RFC and prerequisite stack remain open.

options.title: Accept the gated package API
options.body: Approve the existing package API as the experimental discovery surface, then require stack refresh and live enabled/disabled proof before merge.

options.title: Use an isolated Claw API
options.body: Require a separate experimental endpoint so existing package-family clients never encounter the new contract.

options.title: Pause for RFC resolution
options.body: Keep the stack unmerged until the permanent Claw registry direction is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Accept the gated package API
recommendation.body: Approve the existing package API as the experimental discovery surface, then require stack refresh and live enabled/disabled proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent ownership of package publication gating and public visibility makes this the strongest available routing candidate.
